title: objectstack-ask skill: teach query_dataset's totalGroups next to truncated
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGvw43spR79ztEvWt

## What

PR #35201 (card #35194) adds an optional `totalGroups` to `query_dataset`'s output (`QueryDatasetOutputSchema`). It is the number of groups before `offset` and `limit` cut the result, with the same name and meaning as `aggregate_records`. It is absent where the database could not count them.

`skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md` (served as `packages/mcp/src/ask-skill.generated.ts`) already teaches `truncated: true` ("more rows existed than came back"). It doesn't yet teach the client to answer "how many X are there" after a top-N cut from `totalGroups`, or to say the total is unknown when `totalGroups` is absent.

## Scope

Add one line beside the `truncated` lines, then regenerate `ask-skill.generated.ts`. This is `skills/**`, so it needs a domain:skills PR, which is why it is not in the domain:server PR #35201. If the skill teaches `aggregate_records`' `totalGroups` by the time this is picked up (#35144 / PR #35193), use one shared sentence for both.

Blocked until #35201 merges.

## Origin

Card #35194's scope ("the ask skill's served text gains one line, only if it already teaches `truncated`"). It was moved here at claim 6978120534. The #35194 dev report is 6980036117.

Re-check: `git grep -n "totalGroups\|truncated" origin/main -- skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`
